title: salvia vaseyi
intro: Salvia vaseyi, commonly known as Vasey's sage, is a species of flowering plant in the sage family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms associated with menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of Salvia vaseyi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. The health benefits of Salvia vaseyi may include improved cognitive function, reduced stress and anxiety, and enhanced immune system function.
